mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.debit - o.credit) FROM fin_account_opening o JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = o.account_id WHERE a.code LIKE '1001%' OR a.code LIKE '1002%'), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.debit - e.credit) FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE a.code LIKE '1001%' OR a.code LIKE '1002%'), 0)

SELECT CASE WHEN b.kind = 'AR' THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END AS direction, b.kind AS source, b.id AS ref_id, b.bill_no AS ref_no, COALESCE(c.name, s.name) AS partner_name, b.due_date, b.amount - b.settled_amount AS amount FROM fin_bill b LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON b.kind = 'AR' AND c.id = b.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON b.kind = 'AP' AND s.id = b.partner_id WHERE b.amount <> b.settled_amount AND b.due_date <= #{end} UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN n.kind = 'RECEIVABLE' THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END, CASE WHEN n.kind = 'RECEIVABLE' THEN 'NOTE_IN' ELSE 'NOTE_OUT' END, n.id, n.note_no, COALESCE(nc.name, ns.name), n.due_date, n.amount FROM fin_note n LEFT JOIN scm_customer nc ON n.kind = 'RECEIVABLE' AND nc.id = n.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier ns ON n.kind = 'PAYABLE' AND ns.id = n.partner_id WHERE ((n.kind = 'RECEIVABLE' AND n.status = 'HELD') OR (n.kind = 'PAYABLE' AND n.status = 'ISSUED')) AND n.due_date <= #{end} UNION ALL SELECT 'OUT', 'CLAIM', ec.id, ec.claim_no, u.nickname, ec.claim_date, ec.amount FROM fin_expense_claim ec LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ec.user_id WHERE ec.status = 'APPROVED' AND ec.claim_date <= #{end} UNION ALL SELECT p.direction, 'PLAN', p.id, NULL, p.description, p.plan_date, p.amount FROM fin_fund_plan_item p WHERE p.plan_date <= #{end}
